role: In-repo snapshot harness: renders a SwiftUI view to RGBA via ImageRenderer at fixed size/scale/light/en_US/America-Chicago time zone, rejects blank renders, and compares against gzipped raw references in EmuquTests/__Snapshots__ with a per-channel tolerance and a fixed changed-pixel allowance; SNAPSHOT_RECORD=1 rewrites references and fails.
state: SnapshotTesting.timeZone = America/Chicago (.gmt if the identifier fails to resolve)

units.does: Sets the process default time zone (NSTimeZone.default) to SnapshotTesting.timeZone for the duration of the call and restores the host's on exit; renders the view framed to `size` on systemBackground in light mode, en_US locale, SnapshotTesting.timeZone, LTR via ImageRenderer at scale 1, then draws the CGImage into an sRGB premultiplied-last RGBA buffer; returns (pixels,width,height) or nil on any failure.
writes: NSTimeZone.default (set for the render, restored by defer on every return)
